name: Line Rider P&S Demo
summary:
Line Rider: Plane and Simple brings the legendary sledding sandbox into VR. Draw your own track and watch a little dude ride it. Hills, loops, jumps, trick combos, whatever you can sketch. Easy to start, very hard to master.

This demo focuses on the riding. You get 15 Challenge levels plus YOLO mode, where you draw in real time just ahead of the rider and try to keep him alive as long as you can (way harder than it looks).

The classic sandbox mode comes with the complete game.
